schema_note: Advisory visual recipes and exemplars retrieved on demand by directors and exemplar_retrieval.py. Never executed as a rigid template; episodes may author open primitives bound by Layer 1 Brand DNA.

grammar_triggers.condition: When the narration anchors geographic location, spatial reach, or regional context on the primary map spine
grammar_triggers.action: Keep a continuous virtual-camera move over graded bathymetric marine-teal satellite relief with warm natural landmass relief, updating one focal graphic per stressed noun.
grammar_triggers.rationale: A living bathymetric satellite spine carries 70-90% of runtime while letting foreground signals breathe.

grammar_triggers.condition: When introducing a focal territory, country, or contested zone as the narrative subject
grammar_triggers.action: Trace the exterior perimeter along real coastlines first, then land a crisp white-rimmed or molten crimson-with-amber-glow polygon fill while keeping terrain readable.
grammar_triggers.rationale: Perimeter draw-on before fill makes geographic extent unmistakable before naming the subject.

grammar_triggers.condition: When narration states a distance, corridor width, span, or comparative geographic measurement
grammar_triggers.action: Render a dual_unit_distance_bracket (white double-headed arrow, T-bracket, or dashed corridor) aligned to the feature axis with paired metric and imperial figures matching spoken numbers.
grammar_triggers.rationale: Axis-aligned dual-unit brackets make spatial scale legible immediately across audiences.

grammar_triggers.condition: When comparing an unfamiliar region's area or length to a familiar reference country or continent
grammar_triggers.action: Tile bright sky-cyan reference country silhouettes directly inside the focal polygon (silhouette_tile) or transplant a true-scale cutout over a cobalt blueprint backdrop.
grammar_triggers.rationale: True-scale silhouette tiling proves magnitude instantaneously without abstract bar charts.

grammar_triggers.condition: When national sovereignty, ownership, or border division is central to the clause
grammar_triggers.action: Fill the entire exterior coastline with a waving, luminous-rimmed flag_fill (polygon or country_block_3d) revealed organically; never use small floating rectangular flag pins.
grammar_triggers.rationale: Full-territory cloth flags communicate sovereignty cleanly over graded terrain or ocean.

grammar_triggers.condition: When explaining vertical facts such as mountain barriers, cruising altitude, cabin depressurization, or steep terrain clearance
grammar_triggers.action: Shift into a sunlit daylight 3D horizon terrain flight (surface_register: daylight_terrain) paired with left-anchored translucent cyan dual-unit altitude chips and crisp white T-cap hairlines.
grammar_triggers.rationale: Vertical barriers cannot be felt top-down; daylight 3D relief with horizontal reference chips proves clearance physically.

grammar_triggers.condition: When proving air/maritime traffic density, no-fly holes, parallel corridors, or coverage blackout zones
grammar_triggers.action: Switch to a matte slate charcoal radar canvas populated with dense yellow vehicle icons, isolating anomalies with a circular white-rimmed zoom loupe or neon green vs crimson coverage zones.
grammar_triggers.rationale: Matte charcoal strips geographic noise so real-world traffic flows and voids read at a glance.

grammar_triggers.condition: When explaining prevailing winds, jet streams, ocean currents, or asymmetric directional travel times
grammar_triggers.action: Animate translucent directional chevrons (chevron_flow_band) with glowing cyan speed typography and contrast opposing routes using semantic green vs crimson-pink dashed arcs and duration badges.
grammar_triggers.rationale: Animated chevrons and color-coded return legs turn invisible atmospheric forces into tangible map physics.

grammar_triggers.condition: When isolating a weird border zigzag, narrow traffic corridor, or small island anomaly during a hook or pivot
grammar_triggers.action: Draw an overlapping hand-drawn electric-yellow Bezier oval (organic_focus_lasso) directly around the anomaly, optionally desaturating the surrounding map so the circled zone is the sole saturated signal.
grammar_triggers.rationale: A hand-drawn yellow lasso directs the eye immediately without enclosing geography in a rigid box.

grammar_triggers.condition: When introducing an institutional system, aviation/maritime acronym, or multi-agency control network
grammar_triggers.action: Land an oversized yellow Montserrat Black acronym hero (acronym_hero) with yellow-initial expansion, then illuminate color-coded translucent control sector polygons and parallel directional lane arrows.
grammar_triggers.rationale: Bold acronym typography followed by translucent spatial sectors demystifies complex coordination systems.

grammar_triggers.condition: When framing idealized global rules, longitudinal grids, architectural footprints, or scale comparisons
grammar_triggers.action: Frame the pitched 3D map or lifted continent cutout over a vivid cobalt-blue drafting grid (blueprint_tabletop_frame or blueprint theme: cobalt) with crisp white coordinate lines.
grammar_triggers.rationale: A royal-cobalt drafting backdrop signals analytical rules and scale proof distinct from everyday terrain.

grammar_triggers.condition: When explaining subsurface geology, ocean trenches, root erosion, or port draft clearance that top-down maps cannot show
grammar_triggers.action: Cut via radial zoom-blur into a full-bleed edge-to-edge 2D flat-vector cutaway (cutaway_2d or cross_section_diagram) with clean horizontal labels and an understated NOT TO SCALE micro note when exaggerated.
grammar_triggers.rationale: Full-bleed 2D cutaways expose vertical or subsurface causes directly without cramped dashboard cards.

grammar_triggers.condition: When narration uses deadpan irony, a hypothetical neighbor scenario, or human-scale absurdity across a boundary
grammar_triggers.action: Zoom into a real street or border split with opposing hatched colors and stage two flat-vector circular avatars with crisp one-line speech bubbles for one bounded comedic beat, then return to the map.
grammar_triggers.rationale: Brief, motivated human-scale comedy turns abstract border or time-zone rules into memorable intuition.

grammar_triggers.condition: When closing a systems or logistics story on calm precision, coordination, or safety
grammar_triggers.action: Transition to a deep abyssal slate-teal 2D editorial canvas showing stylized dark silhouettes or clean synchronized vector formations that visualize order directly.
grammar_triggers.rationale: A quiet stylized 2D closing register gives systems stories an unmistakable signature finish.

grammar_triggers.condition: When narration hinges on an asymmetric population split or demographic percentage across a geographic divider
grammar_triggers.action: Split a boxless 10-figure human silhouette row (demographic_icon_grid) physically across the glowing meridian or border before swapping to compact count readouts.
grammar_triggers.rationale: Ten human silhouettes dividing across a line make ratios felt faster than raw percentages alone.

grammar_triggers.condition: When debunking a misconception count or isolating overlapping border/territory totals from busy terrain
grammar_triggers.action: Sweep a vertical white divider bar (split_wipe_divider) to isolate focal hatched territories over matte dark obsidian while a tabular odometer counter ticks past the believed number.
grammar_triggers.rationale: A counter that refuses to stop over a dark isolated map makes misconceptions visibly collapse.

grammar_triggers.condition: When narration rewinds into treaty history, colonial partitions, or multi-century border evolution
grammar_triggers.action: Shift to warm sepia parchment relief or an upright 0-degree unfolding parchment sheet (historical_parchment_plate) paired with bold serif era stamps and a thin upper-safe golden timeline bar.
grammar_triggers.rationale: Warm parchment visually separates historical intent from modern satellite evidence without narration clutter.

grammar_triggers.condition: When terrain texture, weather severity, or physical hostility must be felt beyond cartography
grammar_triggers.action: Plunge via radial whip-zoom into 3-4 concise real aerial or field proof clips (0.85-2.0 s each) cut on stressed nouns beneath steady lower-band captions, then return to the map.
grammar_triggers.rationale: Short real-footage bursts ground abstract map claims in visceral physical texture.

grammar_triggers.condition: When illustrating physical subsea cables, pipelines, power grids, maritime fleets, or volumetric urban footprints
grammar_triggers.action: Place world-locked 3D map geometry (cable_3d strictly for physical conduits, model_3d or custom SVG map_sprites for vehicles/assets, volume_3d prisms for footprint proof) directly on the pitched map.
grammar_triggers.rationale: Unified 3D spatial geometry proves engineering constraints directly inside the map world.

grammar_triggers.condition: When switching basemap registers at identical camera framing (satellite to radar, parchment, or dark vector)
grammar_triggers.action: Use a 6-frame feathered black-disc sweep (disc_sweep) or feathered_dark_wipe crossing right-to-left while match-framing both sides and keeping lower-band captions unmasked.
grammar_triggers.rationale: A match-framed register sweep reads as re-examining the same place through a new analytical lens.

exemplar_bank.notes: Opens on colored vertical time-zone bands framed by a vivid cobalt blueprint grid, then cuts to a desaturated close-up where only the zigzag border glows coral-red inside an electric-yellow hand-drawn oval lasso.

Zooms into an aerial city street divided by a crisp yellow line (yellow UTC-8 hatch vs cyan UTC-7 hatch) with two flat-vector circular avatars exchanging a one-line coffee joke before returning to global borders.

Illuminates France and twelve overseas zones with luminous gold hotspots, then shifts to crimson-filled China with high-contrast dark ink typography and five translucent blue bands collapsing into +8, closing on yellow Kashgar.

Ignites the Tibetan Plateau in molten crimson with a bright golden-amber rim over bathymetric satellite Asia, then tiles bright sky-cyan France silhouettes directly inside the plateau to prove its area.
Cuts to a matte charcoal air-traffic canvas filled with dense yellow aircraft icons orbiting an empty crimson-ringed void over Tibet with clean white-on-red plateau typography.

Sweeps through natural daylight 3D Himalayan peaks with left-edge translucent cyan dual-unit altitude chips (33,000 ft / 14,800 ft / 10,000 ft), a crisp side-profile 2D aircraft descending on a red warning triangle.
Returns top-down to escalate through animated white turbulence streamlines and a clean circular prohibition mark over a flat-vector runway icon, ending directly on the final hazard fact.
Shows a curved stream of white aircraft crossing rich bathymetric Atlantic Ocean water, circled by an electric-yellow hand-drawn lasso above subdued translucent teal ocean typography.
Switches to dark charcoal radar traffic, punches a crisp white-rimmed circular zoom loupe over parallel flight tracks flanked by bold white question marks, then pivots via a deep-emerald 3D globe.
Sweeps translucent white jet-stream chevrons west-to-east with glowing cyan 320 km/h (200 mi/h) speed typography, a fuel gauge icon, and contrasting pink 8h westbound vs green 7h eastbound arcs.

Contrasts glowing green coastal radar with a crimson mid-ocean blackout zone, lands bold yellow NAT acronym typography, illuminates four translucent oceanic control sectors, and draws neon red/green parallel lane arrows.
Closes on a calm deep slate-teal 2D editorial canvas where dark silhouetted controller hands position glowing white aircraft into a serene parallel grid.
Lifts a crimson territory silhouette over a cobalt blueprint world grid onto Europe with perpendicular dual-unit metric/imperial distance brackets.
Radial whip-zoom plunge into four concise aerial rainforest, river, and mountain-ridge clips (0.9-2.2 s each) grounding cartographic obstacles beneath clean centered lower-band captions.
Sweeps a crisp vertical white divider bar from satellite relief to matte dark vector with diagonal-hatched neighbor territories and a live yellow counter.
Continuous satellite glide over North America splitting a 10-figure human silhouette row across a glowing cyan meridian before revealing drifting rain-shadow clouds.
Cuts via radial zoom-blur into a full-bleed flat-vector 2D soil and root cross-section explaining prairie wind erosion, followed by a vertical storm-height ruler.
Stamps a high-contrast crimson circular X over the common summit assumption before revealing a rotating 3D oblate geoid globe with polar compression arrows.
Draws a glowing dashed biogeographic boundary between islands before cutting to a full-bleed 2D underwater trench cross-section with paired metric/imperial depth callouts.
Shifts smoothly into warm sepia parchment cartography with an upright 0-degree treaty unfold, bold serif year stamp, and thin upper-safe golden era timeline.
Three crisp real aerial icebreaker clips paired with one boxless tabular distance metric parked cleanly away from the vessel silhouette.
Pulls out to a whole-route globe tallying elapsed years and distance, then dives back onto the remaining dashed white projection to close on an open future horizon.
